why: In next/, wrote the laws of docs/plan/quests/t753-l16-full-depth-PLAN.md: A1 to A5 (spans of one call commit together) as a suite in libfabrika's telemetry module run by node/SinkBatch.test.ts, A6 (every Process and Project call commits its spans in at most 2 and 1 sink transactions) in cloudflare/call-spans.laws.test.ts, and B1 to B3 (a runner reads its lifecycle once per serial step; what it answers follows the process table; only its own built-in exit writes normal) as a suite in runtime/RunnerLifecycleTest.ts run by node/RunnerLifecycle.test.ts. On main, A2, A3, A4, A6 and B1 are red for the reason the plan gives (a flush inside a batch ships 0 of 1 span, the wrapping tracer's tag is missing, a late span is lost, a Project call lands 2 spans in 2 transactions where a Process msg lands 37 in 37, a counter step reads the lifecycle 12 times against a budget of 3). A1, A5, B2 and B3 are green on main and each bit under its plant. The three product files and L16 are untouched.
note: Started time is the first observed shell timestamp; usage and cost are not recorded. Plants that need the build's code are named, not run: A2 (flush skips the open batch), A3 (restore the tracer swap), A4 (ignore the batch's sink; drop the closed check), A6 (remove the batch from attributed or wrapped; batch outside the runner's flush) and the B2 snapshot plants (exit does not drop it; kept past a step; live without the process id). The ChildrenLedger stop_child path of B3 and the stop_child and start_child moves of B1 are not walked: the runner world has no Children service. Process call bound of 2 transactions and B1's budget of 3 reads per serial step are read from the plan's walk-through and are unmeasured against the build.
